title: Expanded Batch B package displaces trusted overlap-path evidence with cross-DLL lookalikes
symptom: Wave-2 Batch B is internally trusted and overlap-baseline comparable, but 18 previously verified overlap functions regress because denser cross-DLL context introduces plausible-but-wrong artifacts that outrank or replace the trusted overlap-path evidence.

observed_bad_argument_shapes: workflow consumers receiving CFG-* tickets instead of workflow handles
pricing quote consumers receiving licensed|cust=... approval tickets instead of PRQ-* quote ids
reporting close calls receiving reservation ids instead of RPT-* report ids
config approval calls reusing ticket strings as nonce values

trust_impact: Package expansion is now comparable enough to trust the regression surface, but the current evidence-selection layer is not robust enough to preserve previously verified overlap paths under denser cross-DLL seeding.
allowed_next_actions: investigate overlap regressions on workflow, pricing, config, and reporting only
tighten same-lineage and same-family evidence preference under expansion pressure
add bounded expansion-wave guards that preserve trusted overlap-path evidence unless stronger same-family evidence exists
rerun wave-2-batch-b only after a generic evidence-selection fix
disallowed_next_actions: promote a new architecture tranche from this Batch B result
patch Contoso-specific identifiers into pipeline core
treat the regressions as mere comparability noise
exit_criteria: the carried-forward 6-DLL overlap no longer shows unexplained regressions
trusted overlap-path working calls survive the denser 8-DLL package context
